## Recovered observations

174 points (from FA-22) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appa-b2`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Inset D50 1.1 mm (0.9-2.5); D10 0.07 mm (0.06-0.1); Cu printed '2 5' read 25 (range 15-25); D95 5.0 mm (4.1-5.5). A-49: average combines used and unused soil; wide range from segregation (soil shoveled; no vacuum handling). Table 2-3 prints Cu 17.0 and D95 4.7; the F2-14 footnote says unused undegraded samples.
- Codex: Six samples; A-49 says combined used and unused soil; individual sample identities missing. Cu average appears spaced 2 5. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. A-22, printed A-46, PDF 47
